streamItems.title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday November 2026, (Tue, Nov 10th)

streamItems.title: eMudhra revokes 8 more CA certificates after private key mishap
streamItems.summary: Certificate authority eMudhra has revoked eight additional intermediate CA certificates after an investigation into its recent certificate security incident found improper handling of private keys during the certificate-generation process. [...]
